name: status-steady
//: The ⚡ status in Overleaf's toolbar stays put while builds come fast: its slot is a fixed width (the buttons after it never move, whatever it says), and its words are drawn at most about four times a second, the latest. Before: it flickered between labels and moved the toolbar with every build's milliseconds.

steps.what: (the tab's CPU six times slower, as a loaded runner's: a first page over a second, then builds of a few hundred ms; the status must keep one width through the change of its words)

steps.eval: (() => { const st = document.getElementById('phitex-status'); const next = st.parentElement.lastElementChild; const s = globalThis.__steady = { xs: new Set(), ws: new Set(), texts: [], t0: performance.now(), on: true }; let last = ''; const f = () => { if (!s.on) return; s.xs.add(Math.round(next.getBoundingClientRect().left)); s.ws.add(Math.round(st.getBoundingClientRect().width)); const lf = document.getElementById('phitex-left'), at = (e) => Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().width); const c = [Math.round(next.getBoundingClientRect().left), at(st), lf.className, document.getElementById('phitex-controls')?.className.replace('pdfjs-viewer-controls ', ''), document.getElementById('phitex-switch')?.className.replace('editor-toggle-switch', 'sw'), [...lf.children].map(at).join(','), [...document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar-pdf-left > *, .toolbar-pdf-right button')].filter((e) => e.offsetWidth).map(at).join(','), document.fonts.status].join(' | '); if (c !== s.lc) ((s.log = s.log ?? []).push(Math.round(performance.now() - s.t0) + ' ms: ' + c + ' | ' + st.textContent), (s.lc = c)); const t = st.textContent; if (t !== last) (s.texts.push([Math.round(performance.now() - s.t0), t]), (last = t)); requestAnimationFrame(f); }; f(); })()

steps.type: quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

steps.what: (each change of the toolbar while recorded: when, the next item's x, the status's width, the classes, every item's width, the fonts' status, the words)
(each change of what gave way in the toolbar, and what decided it)
nothing after the status moved, and the status kept one width

steps.what: the toolbar settled in one pass once drawn whole: what gives way decided together, never a step a tick
the words drawn no faster than four times a second (changes per second, rounded up)
steps.check: (() => { const t = globalThis.__steady.texts; const span = Math.max(1, (t.at(-1)[0] - t[0][0]) / 1000); return t.length <= Math.ceil(span * 4) + 1; })()
